upload.itMessage:
Hello IT team,

For the Sanford ERP migration of {{company}} ({{name}}), please run the attached 05_hana_export.sql on the HANA schema {{schema}}:

1. Query 1 → save as columns.csv (column order; the data files have no header)
2. Query 2 → save as constraints.csv (real table keys)
3. Query 4 → save as row_counts.csv (rows per table)
4. Query 9 (EXPORT "{{schema}}"."*" AS CSV) → the data export folder

Please use CSV, not Excel (Excel changes some table names, e.g. AUG1 becomes a date). Zip the export folder together with the three CSV files and upload it in Super ERP › Back Office › Upload backup, or send me the link.

Thank you

st.noAuthorizer: No authorizer yet. Add a position or a user.
st.noneBody: Create a stage, then use it in an approval template.
st.changedPending: Stage saved. {{n}} request(s) waiting at this stage now go to the new authorizers.
st.deleteBody: Stage {{name}} will be removed. A stage used in a template or with requests waiting can't be deleted.
st.ownerFallback: No authorizer: the owner position ({{pos}}) decides
st.short: Only {{n}} person(s) can approve here today.
st.liveRule: Authorizer changes apply at once, also to requests already waiting at the stage. Changes to templates apply to documents submitted afterwards.

tpl.title: Approval Templates
tpl.desc: Which documents need approval, from whom (originators), when (conditions) and through which stages.
tpl.formDesc: Originators, ordered stages and conditions. A template applies to new documents once it is active.
tpl.rule: Several active templates can match one document: each adds its stages. Deactivating a template keeps its history; waiting requests carry on.
tpl.name: Template name
tpl.noneBody: Create a template to require approval for a document.
tpl.deactivated: Template {{name}} is inactive. {{n}} waiting request(s) carry on.
tpl.originatorsHelp: Whose documents need this approval. Leave empty for everyone.
tpl.noStage: No stage yet. Add at least one.
tpl.noFields: This document has no conditions: every request from the originators needs approval.
tpl.conditionsHelp: All conditions must hold. Without a condition the template always applies.
tpl.pendingNote: {{n}} request(s) are waiting under this template. They keep the stages they were sent to.
tpl.legacyNote: Created from the earlier approval rules. Saving it here makes this screen its only place to change.
tpl.deleteBody: A template that was never used can be deleted. Used templates are deactivated instead.
tpl.leaveBody: Line manager, then the HR approver ({{hr}}), then the owner ({{owner}}) above {{n}} days. Change it in HR Setup.

rep.title: Approval Status Report
rep.desc: Every approval request of the company: where it waits, under which template, and what was decided.
